title: Mentioning the same colleague twice in one chat message is accepted
preconditions: Session: the BUYER. The sandbox event ({{eventGroupUuid}}) is published, its single price round {{tradeId}} is open, one line item, no bids. {{userUuid}} is an active user of this workspace.
steps: 1. POST /remarks on the price round with a message that mentions <U#{{userUuid}}> twice.
expectedResult: HTTP 200, the remark is saved and the colleague mentioned once. Today: HTTP 422 code 101 'You are not allowed to perform this action' — get_user_ids keeps duplicates while the user lookup is distinct, so 2 != 1 (app/services/expression_evaluator/expression_evaluator_service.rb:30-33).
rationale: A refusal of an ordinary message is a defect; the count compares a list with duplicates to a distinct set.
notes: Mentions the signed-in buyer itself, never another workspace user (a mention notifies the person).

title: Mentioning someone who is not in the workspace is refused
preconditions: Session: the BUYER. The sandbox event ({{eventGroupUuid}}) is published, its single price round {{tradeId}} is open, one line item, no bids. Z2dnWmdaUWtnZw== decodes to id 999999999 (no such user).
steps: 1. POST /remarks on the price round mentioning <U#Z2dnWmdaUWtnZw==>.
2. The message must not be saved.
expectedResult: HTTP 422, code 101 'You are not allowed to perform this action' — the mentioned id is not an active user of the workspace (app/services/expression_evaluator/expression_evaluator_service.rb:29-34).
rationale: A mention mails the person; an outsider or a forged id must never be accepted.

title: A plain chat message on a live price round is saved
preconditions: Session: the BUYER. The sandbox event ({{eventGroupUuid}}) is published, its single price round {{tradeId}} is open, one line item, no bids.
steps: 1. POST /remarks on the price round with a plain message, no mentions, no attachments.
expectedResult: HTTP 200; the remark is created (no mentions → saved as written, app/services/expression_evaluator/expression_evaluator_service.rb:35-39).
rationale: Positive control for the mention refusals.

title: A chat message with eleven attachments is refused
preconditions: Session: the BUYER. The sandbox event ({{eventGroupUuid}}) is published, its single price round {{tradeId}} is open, one line item, no bids.
steps: 1. POST /remarks on the price round with eleven attachment links.
expectedResult: HTTP 422 — code 101 when the links are not this company's storage (validate_company_urls, app/controllers/api/remarks_controller.rb:31), else code 864 'Number of attachments exceed the maximum allowed limit' (expression_evaluator_service.rb:37). Either way refused, never saved, never 5xx.
rationale: The attachment cap is the only upload limit on chat.

preconditions: Session: the BUYER. The sandbox event ({{eventGroupUuid}}) is published, its single price round {{tradeId}} is open, one line item, no bids.
rationale: Opened by the counter-offer screen before the first bid.

title: Line-wise savings on a live round with no bids answer empty, not an error
preconditions: Session: the BUYER. The sandbox event ({{eventGroupUuid}}) is published, its single price round {{tradeId}} is open, one line item, no bids.
expectedResult: HTTP 200 with no savings entries (or a typed 4xx if the client has no savings configuration); never 5xx — a nil reference list must not crash (app/controllers/concerns/trade_template_helper.rb:469-470).
rationale: Opened by the live page; the nil-reference path is crash-shaped.
